name: The Westin Resort, Costa Navarino
positioning: A family-focused beach resort on the Ionian Sea in Costa Navarino, among olive groves and golf courses, with rooms inspired by Messinian mansions
best_for: Families who want kids' hubs, an Aqua Park and youth sports programmes by the sea
Golfers and tennis players who want a beach resort with signature courses and a Mouratoglou Tennis Center

facts.text: The resort is on the Ionian Sea in Costa Navarino, surrounded by centuries-old olive groves, golf courses and a sandy beach.
Room and suite design is inspired by old Messinian mansions.
The two-level Westin Pool spans two separate pools with a waterfall backdrop.
The palm-fringed Lagoon Pool is at the heart of the resort and has a kids' pool.
The WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio has an indoor pool.
The seasonal Aqua Park has three slides and a play pool.
The resort has two children's hubs, Cocoon and SandCastle.
Sports programmes for young guests include the NBA Basketball School, Juventus Academy Resort Experience and Mouratoglou Junior Tennis Camp.
The 1827 bar is named after the naval battle in the nearby Bay of Navarino during the Greek War of Independence.

highlights.text: The Dunes Beach is a sandy, west-facing beach on the Ionian Sea that stretches for 1 km, with sun loungers and umbrellas.
Many rooms and suites have unobstructed Ionian Sea views, and some ground-floor units have an individual infinity pool.
Anazoe Spa treatments combine ancient Greek healing rituals and local resources such as olive leaves, Messinian citrus, herbs, flowers and sea salts with European spa therapies.
The Dunes Course, designed by Bernhard Langer with European Golf Design, is the first signature golf course in Greece, with sea and river views.
The Mouratoglou Tennis Center, its first European location, has 12 tennis courts, 3 padel courts and 2 pickleball courts with Ionian Sea views.

considerations.text: The resort is a 45-minute drive from Kalamata Airport and three hours from Athens Airport.
WhataHotel notes the remote location means off-resort outings need planned transportation.
